description: Source code for E2 connection handler managing E2AP message forwarding, connection lifecycle, and TNL association in a 5G network component.

classes.name: e2_rx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward E2AP Rx PDUs from E2 GW to E2 Agent, signals connection loss on destruction.

classes.name: e2_tx_channel
classes.description: Adapter class to forward E2AP Tx PDUs to E2 GW, manages lifetime of TNL connection, and logs warnings if down.

methods.name: connect_to_ric
methods.description: Establishes connection to RIC, creates Rx and Tx notifiers, and returns a Tx channel for message forwarding.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss
methods.description: Dispatches handling of connection loss to the E2AP executor, retries if task queue is full.

methods.name: handle_connection_loss_impl
methods.description: Performs cleanup on connection loss: marks as disconnected, resets notifier, and signals disconnection.

methods.name: handle_tnl_association_removal
methods.description: Asynchronous handler to remove TNL association, stops Tx path, and waits for Rx disconnection.
